-pode.et: From the stem of Ancient Greek πούς (poús).

Podium.et: From Latin podium, from Ancient Greek πόδιον (pódion, “foot of vase”), diminutive of πούς (poús, “foot”).

Podcaster.et: Borrowed from English podcaster or from Podcast + -er.
